name: Koala
long_description:
PROBLEM 😩

Zoom is great for adults, not ideal to engage an 8 year old online.

SOLUTION 🔥

Koala Go, the award-winning interactive platform for online teaching businesses.

Learn more at https://teachwithkoala.com/

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Xavier was born and raised in Paris, France. 
When he turned 21, he got an internship at Apple in California and never came back to France.
Xavier currently lives in San Francisco with his fiancée.
He would not trade his entrepreneurial life for anything.
Xavier's favorite TV show are West Wing and Friends.
He's a decent skier, basketball player and plays real time strategy games.

launches.title: 🐨 Learn with Koala
launches.tagline: Igniting a love of learning in every child
launches.body:
**Tl;dr Dear parents, fun live online classes made for kids now exist.** [**Koala**](https://www.learnwithkoala.com) **is a fun alternative to Zoom for kids’ online classes. 🌅**\
\
Hi 👋🏽, we’re [Xavier](https://www.linkedin.com/in/xavier-lesage-moretti/) (left) and [Ben](https://www.linkedin.com/in/benjamin-roux-3b224237) (right). 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68181&key=user_uploads/722547/644eec02-04f8-439b-809a-65eaa5f4a36f)

We’re ex-Apple engineers, raised by teachers. We were also each other’s best men 🤵🏽

—

# 🧠 “Play is our brain’s favorite way of learning.”

Right?

But for kids, live online classes feel like

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68181&key=user_uploads/89898/db10a76d-b9d8-4c59-bb13-bc6ddde51086)

**That’s why we co-founded** [**Koala**](https://www.learnwithkoala.com/)**.**

A fun alternative to Zoom for kids’ online classes. It looks like this:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68181&key=user_uploads/722547/6602212c-2b53-4dab-87b3-84df77568cc2)

Inspired by Minecraft, Koala quickly attracted thousands of teachers and their students. Kids and teachers loved it.

💚 Our community of teachers helped us iterate fast on our MVP\
🥳 We got into YC W22\
🥇 Koala won awards

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68181&key=user_uploads/89898/4fae7fb1-f415-4ed3-8eec-6434a98caac5)

# 

# **🔥 Today, we’re launching our new product: Learn with Koala**

Fun live online classes you can book for your kids with the best teachers.

Our 3 favorite classes:

* [**Introduction to Chinese** by an ex-startup exec \[5 - 8 years old\]](https://www.learnwithkoala.com/classes/52e67bd4-baad-4c4c-b245-dac23504aed0?utm_source=Launch+YC&utm_medium=Post&utm_campaign=top+3+classes)
* [**Code a video game** with a Y Combinator CTO \[10 - 14 years old\]](https://www.learnwithkoala.com/classes/0d21c80a-0453-4d0d-bf6c-913cf9040c7b?utm_source=Launch+YC&utm_medium=Post&utm_campaign=top+3+classes)
* [**English for non-native speakers** by Mrs Emily \[4 - 9 years old\]](https://www.learnwithkoala.com/classes/8cc956fb-21df-4cb6-8c88-934b98b5911f?utm_source=Launch+YC&utm_medium=Post&utm_campaign=top+3+classes)

—

# ❤️ Want to support us?

Book one of the 3 classes above or any class at <https://www.learnwithkoala.com> and **let us know how we can make our product better** 🙏🏼

Don’t go easy on us! 😉

Much love

The Koala founders 🐨
